# Portable 5-Gallon Gas Can Cap

![Render](render.png)

## Description
This is a parametric 3D model of a replacement cap designed for portable 5-gallon gas cans. It can be easily 3D printed to replace a lost, cracked, or broken cap, restoring the original function of the container.

## Try it out
To modify the model or print an STL/3MF file, you can view this live in the OpenSCAD playground by following this link:
[OpenSCAD Playground](https://ochafik.com/openscad2/#)
